author: Cleo Abram
description:
Where is our Sun in its lifetime? Halfway through? Closer to the end? If you map out the stars, with the hotter ones toward the left and brighter ones toward the top, you’d get this famous chart showing a star’s life...

Here's where our Sun is in its life right now, and what we think will happen next... 

To find out what’s inside the Sun, subscribe!

#sun #space #animation #science #stemeducation
title: When Will The Sun DIE?
